description: Branch R-SORT-3 LIKE-RANGE-01/05, one factor varied: the presence of an index on the same data. L(ID, K Text(50)) holds 30 values (a, A, ab, a b, a-b, ae, the ligature and expansion forms, accented and decomposed e, s and ss and the sharp s, f and the fi ligature, oe and its ligature, o and o-umlaut, n and n-tilde, b, c, ch, a Null). The same set of LIKE patterns (a*, A*, e*, e-acute*, s*, f*, o*, a?, ?a, *e*) plus K = 'a' and K >= 'a' AND K < 'b' is read (IDs, in ID order) in five states of one table: no index; after CREATE INDEX IX_K; after DROP INDEX; after CREATE INDEX IX_KD on K DESC; after DROP INDEX and CREATE INDEX IX_K again. Asks whether a LIKE result depends on the index, which patterns, and whether the answer repeats.
